# IT City Lucknow Plots

> Independent plot sales service for IT City, the Lucknow Development Authority (LDA) township on Sultanpur Road, Lucknow. Not the official LDA website. Listing updated 22 October 2026.

## Key facts
- Plot sizes on offer: 35, 72, 128, 162, 200 and 288 m² (all six sizes available)
- Location: Sultanpur Road, south-east Lucknow; about 15 km from Hazratganj, 15.8 km from Charbagh station, 16.2 km from Lucknow airport (straight line)
- Township: about 1,054 hectares (about 2,604 acres) across 12 villages, developed by LDA through land pooling
- Sellers: landowners who received developed plots in LDA's land-pooling lotteries (25% of land returned as plots); 2,197 plots to 1,465 farmers in sectors 9, 15, 16, 17, 18 and 30 (Amar Ujala, 14 Oct 2026)
- Transfer rule: in the notified Phase-1 area, a sale needs prior written permission from the District Collector, Lucknow. Permission status is shared for each plot with its price.
- Public LDA scheme: not announced as of 22 October 2026
- Prices: shared on enquiry
- Contact: WhatsApp / call +91 85950 02933
- Page: https://lucknowitcity.in/

## Plot sizes
- 35 m² (377 sq ft, 42 sq yd)
- 72 m² (775 sq ft, 86 sq yd)
- 128 m² (1,378 sq ft, 153 sq yd)
- 162 m² (1,744 sq ft, 194 sq yd)
- 200 m² (2,153 sq ft, 239 sq yd)
- 288 m² (3,100 sq ft, 344 sq yd)
